newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli banks lower prime rate.
newsitem.headline: Israeli banks lower prime rate.

text.p: Israel's major banks said on Wednesday they were lowering their prime rate by 1.2 percentage points to an annualised 14.2 percent from 15.4 percent.
The new rate would be effective Thursday, the banks said in separate statements.
The cut in the prime rate follows the central bank's announcement on Wednesday that it was cutting its key lending rate by 1.2 percentage points to an annualised 12.7 percent, effective Thursday.
The Bank of Israel announced the cut in its key lending rate after the cabinet approved a plan to widen the Israeli currency's trading band.
